title: Prefix of an outward allocation pass
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a,B,j\in\mathbb{N}$, and choose a schedule-symbol input, a base configuration, a valid input-head position, an integer budget-head position, and tapes $\beta,\gamma$. Assume $j\le 3B$ and that $\gamma$ carries the origin mark exactly at coordinate $0$. After $j$ steps from allocation index $0$, with unary head at $1$ over the unary tape with $B$ markers and guide head at $0$, the allocation index is $j$ modulo $3$, the unary head is at $\lfloor j/3\rfloor+1$, and the guide head is at $j$ in the rightward direction or $-j$ in the leftward direction; the guide tape is the result of filling $j$ cells of $\gamma$ in that direction.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
a, B, and j are natural numbers
base is a configuration on the chosen input
p is a valid input-head position
b is an integer budget-head position
bt and gt are guide-related tapes
gt has the origin mark exactly at coordinate 0
replaced:
Let $\gamma$ be a guide tape carrying the origin mark exactly at cell $0$, and let
$j \le 3B$.  From layout phase $0$ (of either direction) with unary head at cell $1$
over the unary tape with $B$ markers and guide head at cell $0$ over $\gamma$, exactly
$j$ steps lead to layout phase $j \bmod 3$ with unary head at
$\lfloor j/3 \rfloor + 1$, guide head at $\pm j$, and guide tape the $j$-cell filled
version of $\gamma$: the elapsed time equals the number of written guide cells, and the
unary head moves once every three cells.
